WITH it1 AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM info_type
  WHERE info = 'countries'
),
it2 AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM info_type
  WHERE info = 'rating'
),
k AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM keyword
  WHERE keyword IN ('murder', 'murder-in-title', 'blood', 'violence')
),
kt AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM kind_type
  WHERE kind IN ('movie', 'episode')
)
SELECT MIN(cn.name) AS movie_company,
       MIN(mi_idx.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS western_violent_movie
FROM title AS t
JOIN kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.movie_id = t.id
JOIN k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
JOIN movie_info AS mi ON mi.movie_id = t.id
JOIN it1 ON it1.id = mi.info_type_id
JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON mi_idx.movie_id = t.id
JOIN it2 ON it2.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = t.id
JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
WHERE t.production_year > 2008
  AND cn.country_code != '[us]'
  AND mc.note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%'
  AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
  AND mi.info IN ('Germany', 'German', 'USA', 'American')
  AND mi_idx.info < '7.0'
